question: Who composed this vārttika and in what place and on what text was it composed?
premises: The author identifies himself as the Kashmirian Abhinavagupta.
The work is composed in the eastern city named Pravarapura.
The composition is a vārttika on the great teaching beginning with the Mālinī.
inference: Therefore this verse serves as a colophon identifying Abhinavagupta of Kashmir as the composer of the vārttika on the Mālinīvijaya in Pravarapura.
plain_english: In the eastern city named Pravarapura, the Kashmirian Abhinavagupta composed this vārttika on the great teaching beginning with the Mālinī.
